scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc --noEmit --incremental false && vite build
scripts.test: sh -c 'budgets=../../../scripts/lib/gate-budgets.sh; if [ ! -r "$budgets" ]; then echo "evener-hub-frontend: cannot read $budgets; refusing to run the test gate unbudgeted" >&2; exit 1; fi; . "$budgets" || { echo "evener-hub-frontend: cannot source $budgets; refusing to run the test gate unbudgeted" >&2; exit 1; }; gate_source_helper ../../../scripts/lib/load-aware-workers.sh; npm run --silent check-package-tests && vitest run $(vitest_run_args) --exclude "scripts/*.test.mjs" "$@" && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs' --
scripts.test:coverage: sh -c 'budgets=../../../scripts/lib/gate-budgets.sh; if [ ! -r "$budgets" ]; then echo "evener-hub-frontend: cannot read $budgets; refusing to run the test gate unbudgeted" >&2; exit 1; fi; . "$budgets" || { echo "evener-hub-frontend: cannot source $budgets; refusing to run the test gate unbudgeted" >&2; exit 1; }; gate_source_helper ../../../scripts/lib/load-aware-workers.sh; npm run --silent check-package-tests && vitest run --coverage $(vitest_run_args) --exclude "scripts/*.test.mjs" "$@" && { [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || node scripts/package-coverage.mjs; }' --
